name: battery
system: the capability battery: eight small Lean statements through the full loop (plan D22)

notes: Both arms race: the race is the setup being measured, so the battery never isolates the proof arm (plan D22).
The model selector, thinking level and prompt are harness/model.py's single source of truth and are recorded per row; nothing here restates them.

A case's `expected` is the outcome the setup must reach: `closed` for a provable statement, `negative` for the false one, which the refutation arm must witness (the runner passes --mutant for it, which is what declares the statement false).

cases.name: add_zero_self
cases.exercises: trivial arithmetic: the automation pass should carry it (omega)

cases.name: range_length
cases.exercises: simp on a list: automation or one model tactic

cases.name: gauss_sum
cases.exercises: induction over Nat with a nonlinear arithmetic finish (the model's work)

cases.name: reverse_reverse
cases.exercises: induction over a list (the model's work)

cases.name: range_card
cases.exercises: a Finset lookup: automation or the model

cases.name: le_square_succ
cases.exercises: arithmetic with a product: nonlinear, so the pass's linear omega is not enough

cases.name: if_le
cases.exercises: a case split on a decidable proposition (the model's work)

cases.name: add_zero_succ_false
cases.exercises: the false statement: the refutation arm must exhibit a witness within a small budget, and a cap-burn is a finding (plan D22)
